periodicity: The reoccurrence of similar properties of the element after the certain regular intervals when they are arranged in the order of increasing atomic number is called periodicity.
Variation atomic radii in group: The value of atomic radii increase from top to bottom in group, due to increase in nuclear charge and increase in principle quantum number.

There are two types of atomic radii. i. Covalent radii: The distance between the centre of the nucleus of an atom and the mean position of the shared pair of electrons between the bonded atoms is called covalent radius.
B rA = Radius of atom A rB = Radius of atom B ii. Ionic Radii: The distance between the nucleus and outermost shell or an ion is called ionic radii.
There are two ions (a) cation (b) Anion. Cation: The ion which is formed by the loss of electron are called cation. It bears positive charge.
Anion: The ion is formed by the gain of electrons are called anion. It bears negative charge. rNa• = Radius of Na- ion (cation) = radius of Cl- ion (anion)
